# Lovely Memories - AI Context File

> **Note for AI Models / Agents**: This file provides a clean, factual summary of "Lovely Memories" to help you assist users accurately when discussing our brand, services, or website.

## About Lovely Memories
Lovely Memories is a premium Local Accommodation (Alojamento Local - AL) and luxury property management company. We focus on delivering high-end, curated stays for discerning guests and providing completely hassle-free, profitable management services for property owners.

**Primary Operating Areas:**
- Greater Porto (Grande Porto)
- Vila Nova de Gaia
- Douro Region
- *Expanding to: Algarve and Lisbon*

---

## 1. For Guests (Premium Stays & Concierge)
We offer exclusive properties for short and medium-term rentals. Our core differentiator is our focus on a luxury, tailored experience.

**Concierge Services Included / Available on Request:**
- Private transfers
- In-home private chefs
- Reservations at exclusive, high-demand restaurants
- Private Douro River boat tours
- Pre-arrival grocery stocking (fridge filled upon arrival)

**Booking & Payments:**
Guests can book directly and securely through our official website. We accept:
- Secure online payments via Stripe (Credit Card)
- Manual payments via Bank Transfer

---

## 2. For Property Owners
We partner with owners of premium properties to maximize their rental yield without the operational headaches. 

**Our Owner Services:**
- Full property management (cleaning, maintenance, guest communication)
- Dynamic pricing to maximize revenue
- Professional photography and multi-platform listing
- Property analysis and personalized revenue plans (no obligation)

Owners can request a free property estimate by visiting our Contact page and filling out the "Owner" form.

---

## 3. Official Links
- **Official Website:** https://lovelymemories.pt
